newsitem.title: UK: Psion rebounds as BZW repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: Psion rebounds as BZW repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in Psion Plc bounced on Tuesday following favourable press comments after the group released its results, dealers said.
The shares, which were up 17-1/2p to 426 at 1025 GMT, also were buoyed by comments from the company's broker, BZW, they said.
BZW repeated a "buy" recommendation, saying the launch of new products will improve the hand-held computer firm's competitive position.
The shares stumbled on Monday after the group, in releasing its results, warned that its margins could come under pressure.

"There were a lot of people who had profits in the shares," said one market maker. "We saw some profit-taking, but (Monday's decline) was overdone. It's a pretty thin market and the shares always overreact."
